newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate rises, baht stronger late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate rises, baht stronger late.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate rose sharply on Friday after the Bank of Thailand moved to tighten liquidity with a bigger weekly bond auction.
Traders said the overnight interbank rate rose to 10.00-10.50 percent range late on Friday from 8.75-9.25 earlier.
Dealers said a central bank decision to increase Friday's bond auction to $200 million, from the $80 million previously planned, had removed cash from the system and seen rates rise.
"I think this is an appropriate level, this is where the Bank of Thailand wants it," said a dealer at Bank of Ayudhya.
The central bank indicated earlier this week that it wishes to see the rate in the 9-11 percent range.
The baht firmed in late active trade on Friday as dollar continued to ease against the yen, traders said. The baht firmed to 25.610/25.626 per dollar from 25.640/25.650 in the morning.

The bid/offer range on the one-month dollar/baht swap premium rose to 8.25/9.00 satangs per dollar from 8.00/8.50 on expectations that the overnight interbank rate would rise to a double digit range early next week.
